data.body: CORRECTION to the immediately preceding comment, whose inline-code identifiers were stripped by shell quoting. Disposable publication rehearsal finding: the first fixed-post identity run was invalid because rewrite-clone still exposed both old tickets and rewritten reclaimed refs; the verifier global position map selected old-epoch anchors, making all 1,129 reported nonverified events appear grandfathered. The same clone synthetic writer branch 9556fb08113da0e89d2aeba715d4e00fbe900433 had merged old tip a7b89a6e7608b3e8ef65c6190c0f3cc06acd62ac, so old-tip ancestry was true. Rebuilt a clean disposable bare remote with only rewritten tip 9ac53960dcf46980a85c5c9e35a0dd3c60ffbda6, then default-cloned it: refs contain only rewritten tickets; old tip is absent; commit count 65,769; merge count 4,469; size-pack 152,488 KiB (<150 MiB). A fixed-verifier identity scan is running against this publication-faithful clone before any synthetic write.
